head.note: my_test-v2 appearance.head is modular, so draw_body replaces the last head layer with modules face. Edit group head still scales catalog head, wounded, and face together. Face has no part.parent; composed anchors hair/beard/scar/bandage to catalog head position, which is also [3, -28].

counts.counting_rule: 30 counts variants; intact/damaged are separate assets, headgear parts are not additional assets. PNG count is not fixed.

geometry_policy.dimensions_source: live baseline + assembler resolved export; do not copy approximate old values
geometry_policy.headgear_extent: measured per design; do not force to face canvas size
geometry_policy.large_fit_change_policy: inspect source-canvas normalization first; return wrong anatomy/perspective to art repair
